(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an __integrated__ open rib structure; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning __at least partially over__ said open rib structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure __without comprising any discontinuities in said first aero cover__; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure __without comprising any discontinuities in said second aero cover__. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least __5.0 GPa__. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene __or another thermoplastic material__ reinforced with 40% long glass fibers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of between __2.0 mm and 3.0 mm__.
